## What's new in Igggy 0.1.16
- **A new install opens properly.** On some Macs, Igggy's first window opened dark and empty, with the welcome text far below the screen. It now opens at a normal size. - **Setup walks you through what matters.** Allow the microphone and computer sound, pick how notes are written, watch the speech model download, connect your calendar. You can go back to any step, and Help → Run Setup Again brings it back later. - **A welcome note.** Your library starts with a short note on where your meetings show up, how to record, and how to reach us. - **Send feedback from the Help menu.** Help → Send Feedback… opens an email to us with your Igggy and Mac versions filled in. - **Every calendar you own.** Igggy now shows meetings from all the Google calendars you own, not only your main one. If Settings → Calendar asks, reconnect once. - **A clearer sidebar.** The note you're on is highlighted in blue, the sidebar button moves with the sidebar as it opens and closes, and a recording's row shows a soft pulse. - **Settings read more easily.** Descriptions sit under what they explain, in one size. AI Models lists the current Claude and GPT models, and says plainly what happens when you use your own account. - **Copies go to any folder.** The Obsidian buttons are gone. Igggy still saves a plain copy of each finished note to whatever folder you choose, your vault included.
